title: 第9章 受辱第10章 形象崩盘
content_zh:
测试中亮起八道光柱，在八古大陆中被称为天选之子。
简单来说，能量球八道光柱的人实在是太少了，概率的话大概是万中无一。或者说这不是一个概率学的问题，而是一种关于血脉的问题。
如果一个人的父母是强者的话，那么孩子生下来的潜力就会很强，所以在子夜国这种小国八道光柱是不可能出现的，但是在浩渺的八古大陆鼎鼎有名的七宗三十六门里，能亮起八道光柱的孩子也并非什么奇怪的事。
但古往今来，在子夜国出现的八道光柱少得可怜，恐怕不超过一手之数，这种属于基因的变异实在是太难得了。更重要的是，每当出现六级天师以上的强者时，往往都会被其他大国给挖走，子夜国这种小国是没有资格留住人的。
这女老师看着八道光柱简直觉得自己的心脏要跳炸了，自己要晕过去一样，那一副表情幸福得仿佛要死过去。反而是那少女，见到亮起八道光柱毫无喜悦，仿佛这就是理所应当一样从八古阵中走出。
“我可以入学了吧？”少女看着呆滞的女老师，微微锁眉，开口提醒道。
少女开口，那女老师猛地打了个激灵，眼神恢复正常，却还是激动得站了起来，大步走到少女面前！
“天选之子！你是我们星火学院第一个天选之子，我们星火学院终于要翻身了！”女老师忍不住激动的情绪，声音甚至都有些颤抖，“你叫什么名字？”
“付雨。”少女抬眼看着激动的女老师，淡漠说道。
“付雨！”女老师深吸一口气，让自己不那么失态，说道，“你被星火学院录取了，星火学院将会以最好的资源来培养你。等你在大陆成为强者以后，不要忘了学院就好！”
付雨看了老师一眼，微微点头，转身便朝着前方的门走去。
吱——咔！
当门关上后，女老师还意犹未尽看着门口。从今年开始，星火学院年年垫底的排名，终于要改变了！
所有通过测试的人，从前门出去后，都会被路标指引到一个偌大的殿堂内。陆安也不例外，他随着人流往前走去。此时的人都是通过测试之人，每个人眼中都闪烁着激动与喜悦的光芒。
当陆安来到这殿堂前时，先是被这殿堂的宏伟再次震撼了一番。
殿堂高达二十余丈，里面由十八根柱子支撑，每一根柱子都需要四五个人合在一起才能抱得住。而且每根柱子上都会有一种不同怪兽的图案，哪怕是看着，陆安也觉得每个怪兽都威风凛凛，站在柱子下会给人无穷的压力。
“你看那边那个土包子，竟然一脸崇拜看着柱子上的奇兽，哈哈哈……”
不知从哪里传来一道声音，顿时让陆安回过神来，皱起眉头。他四周看去，发现右边有七、八个穿着华丽的男男女女坐在长椅上，一直看着自己。
“你看他穿的穷困潦倒的样子，肯定又是哪个穷人家，为了能翻身生了一窝崽子，就为了能有一个通过！”
“咦……你看他穿的这一身，又脏又破，好恶心啊！我可不想和这样的人当同学！”

“我也不想啊！到时候还要分宿舍，谁要是和这家伙住在一起，才是真的倒霉！”
“……”
听着不绝于耳的嘲笑声与厌恶声，陆安眉头越收越紧，他看了一眼那群对自己不停指指点点的贵族子弟们，没有去制止，也没有去报仇，而是转身朝着一边空着的长椅走去。
坐在长椅上，陆安轻吸一口气，跟着自嘲般笑了笑。如果他连这点辱骂都觉得承受不过去的话，那么这些年来他真的早就死了。
四岁的时候，他跟爹娘一起去码头，被要求陪那些富家小孩玩耍。那些小孩骑在他的背上耀武扬威，甚至扮演皇帝让他磕头阿谀奉承，他都做了。眼下这点侮辱，又算得上是什么？
一个奴隶想要活着，最先要学会的就是忍，就是放弃那些不必要的东西。
“喂！”
陆安一愣，低头的他看着突然出现在眼前的几道影子，抬头看向站在面前六个公子哥，这几个人并不是刚刚嘲笑他的那群人。
content_en:
Eight beams of light lit up during the test, and he was known as the Chosen One in the Bagu Continent.
To put it simply, there are too few people with eight beams of light in the energy ball, and the probability is probably only one in ten thousand. In other words, this is not a question of probability, but a question about blood.
If a person's parents are strong, then the potential of the child will be very strong, so it is impossible for the Eight-rayed Light Pillar to appear in a small country like Midnight Kingdom, but in the famous Seven Sects and Thirty-six Sects of the vast Bagu Continent, it is not strange for a child to be able to light up the Eight-rayed Light Pillar.
But throughout the ages, the eight beams of light that have appeared in the Midnight Kingdom have been pitifully few, probably no more than one hand. This kind of genetic mutation is really rare. What's more important is that whenever there is a strong person above the sixth level of Celestial Master, they are often poached by other big countries. A small country like Ziye Kingdom is not qualified to retain people.
The female teacher looked at the eight beams of light and felt as if her heart was going to beat and she was going to faint. Her expression was so happy that she felt like she was about to die. On the contrary, the girl was not happy to see the eight beams of light lit up, and walked out of the Bagu Formation as if it was a matter of course.
"Can I enroll in school?" The girl looked at the dull female teacher, frowned slightly, and reminded her.
When the girl spoke, the female teacher shuddered suddenly, her eyes returned to normal, but she still stood up excitedly and strode to the girl!
"The Chosen Son! You are the first Chosen Son of our Spark Academy. Our Spark Academy is finally about to turn around!" The female teacher couldn't help her excitement, her voice even trembled a little, "What's your name?"
"Fu Yu." The girl looked up at the excited female teacher and said indifferently.
"Fu Yu!" The female teacher took a deep breath to stop herself from losing her composure and said, "You have been admitted to Spark Academy. Spark Academy will train you with the best resources. When you become a strong person in the mainland, don't forget about the academy!"
Fu Yu glanced at the teacher, nodded slightly, turned around and walked towards the door in front.
Squeak - click!
When the door was closed, the female teacher still looked at the door with unfinished thoughts. Starting from this year, Spark Academy’s ranking at the bottom every year will finally change!
All those who pass the test will be directed to a huge hall by road signs after exiting the front door. Lu An was no exception. He walked forward with the flow of people. At this time, everyone has passed the test, and everyone's eyes are shining with excitement and joy.
When Lu An came to the palace, he was first shocked again by the grandeur of the palace.
The hall is more than twenty feet high and is supported by eighteen pillars. Each pillar requires four or five people to hold it together. Moreover, there will be a pattern of a different monster on each pillar. Even looking at it, Lu An feels that each monster is majestic and standing under the pillar will give people endless pressure.
"Look at that country bumpkin over there, looking at the strange beast on the pillar with a look of admiration, hahaha..."
A voice came from somewhere, which immediately brought Lu An back to his senses and frowned. He looked around and saw that on his right there were seven or eight men and women in gorgeous clothes sitting on benches, looking at him.
"Look at the poverty-stricken look he's wearing, he must be from a poor family who gave birth to a litter of babies just so that one of them could pass!"
"Eh... look at what he's wearing. It's dirty and torn. It's so disgusting! I don't want to be a classmate with such a person!"
"I don't want to either! Then we will have to separate dormitories. Whoever lives with this guy will be really unlucky!"
"..."
Listening to the endless laughter and disgust, Lu An frowned more and more. He glanced at the group of aristocratic children who kept pointing fingers at him. He did not stop or take revenge, but turned to the side.walked to the bench.
Sitting on the bench, Lu An took a breath and smiled self-deprecatingly. If he couldn't even bear this insult, he would have died long ago.
When he was four years old, he went to the dock with his parents and was asked to play with the rich kids. Those children rode on his back to show off their power, and even pretended to be the emperor and asked him to kowtow and flatter them, but he did it all. What is this insult now?
If a slave wants to live, the first thing he must learn is tolerance, which is to give up those unnecessary things.
"Hey!"
Lu An was stunned. He lowered his head and looked at several shadows that suddenly appeared in front of him. He looked up at the six young masters standing in front of him. These people were not the group of people who just laughed at him.
